This page presents the learned representations from the ALIGATEHR-Gen model and its quantitative performance against baselines. Explore the ICD code embedding space, compare how 17 models distribute their test AUROC across 1,632 ICD-10 codes, break that distribution down by ICD-10 chapter, and compare evaluation metrics across diseases. The patient embeddings live on the [Use Case](use-case.qmd#patient-embedding) page.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

createScatterplot = (
  await import(await FileAttachment("../frontend/dist/regl-scatterplot.js").url())
).default
```

## ICD-10 Code Embedding UMAP {#icd-embedding}

Use the chatbot to request a reviewed ICD Keyword Match, or search the tracked code nodes directly below. Keyword actions are navigation-only and remain separate from Demo Profile comparison.

Hover a point for its code and title. Click one to open its ICD-10 category and browse the codes underneath it, or pick a chapter from the legend to focus the view on that chapter.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

import { createIcdKeywordScatter } from "./icd-keyword-scatter.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

icdData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/icd_code_embeddings.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Code titles and the ICD hierarchy behind the hover panel. Parsed without
// autoType so every column stays a string.
icdReference = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/icd_code_reference.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof icdSearch = Inputs.text({ label: "Search ICD code or description", placeholder: "e.g. E11, diabetes, circulatory..." })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

icdUmap = {
  const query = icdSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
  const schemeCategory20 = [
    "#1f77b4","#ff7f0e","#2ca02c","#d62728","#9467bd",
    "#8c564b","#e377c2","#7f7f7f","#bcbd22","#17becf",
    "#aec7e8","#ffbb78","#98df8a","#ff9896","#c5b0d5",
    "#c49c94","#f7b6d2","#c7c7c7","#dbdb8d","#9edae5"
  ];
  let removeRequestListener = () => {};
  let chart = null;
  invalidation.then(() => {
    removeRequestListener();
    if (chart) chart.icdKeywordWalkthrough.destroy();
  });

  let helper = window.ALIGATEHR_ICD_KEYWORD;
  for (let attempt = 0; !helper && attempt < 20; attempt += 1) {
    await new Promise(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 50));
    helper = window.ALIGATEHR_ICD_KEYWORD;
  }
  if (!helper) throw new Error("The ICD visualization request helper is unavailable.");

  const consumed = helper.consumeRequest(sessionStorage);
  chart = await createIcdKeywordScatter({
    data: icdData,
    reference: icdReference,
    createScatterplot,
    colors: schemeCategory20,
    searchQuery: query,
    request: consumed.request,
    autoplay: consumed.should_play,
  });
  removeRequestListener = helper.connectRequestConsumer(
    window,
    sessionStorage,
    request => chart.icdKeywordWalkthrough.focus(request),
  );
  window.__ALIGATEHR_ICD_READY__ = true;
  return chart;
}
```

## Per-Code AUROC Across Models {#auroc-distribution}

Every one of the 17 models was scored on the same 1,632 ICD-10 codes, once with the baseline inputs and once with environmental features added. The curves below are Gaussian kernel density estimates of each model's per-code test AUROC (Silverman bandwidth), so a curve further to the right means the model ranks more codes well. A single ICD code has exactly one AUROC per model, which cannot form a density; pick a code to mark where it falls on every curve instead.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

import { bindHighlightGroups, bindHighlightTarget, bindSingleMarkTooltip, createChartTooltip, createHighlightController, highlightOpacity } from "./chart-highlighting.js"
import { MODEL_FAMILIES, modelColor, modelDisplayName, modelFamily, modelFullName, orderModelsByFamily } from "./model-naming.js"
import { ICD_CHAPTERS, chapterByKey, gaussianKde, kdeAt, boxStats, summariseCells, toLongAuroc } from "./auroc-distribution.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

aurocData = {
  const sources = [
    { key: "baseline", label: "Baseline", text: await FileAttachment("data/auroc_by_icd_baseline.csv").text() },
    { key: "plus_env", label: "+ Environment", text: await FileAttachment("data/auroc_by_icd_plus_env.csv").text() },
  ];
  const datasets = new Map();
  let models = null;
  let codes = null;
  sources.forEach((source) => {
    const wide = d3.csvParse(source.text, d3.autoType);
    const columns = wide.columns.filter((column) => column !== "icd");
    const ordered = orderModelsByFamily(columns);
    if (models && ordered.join() !== models.join()) {
      throw new Error("The AUROC tables do not list the same models");
    }
    models = ordered;
    const wideCodes = wide.map((row) => String(row.icd));
    if (codes && wideCodes.join() !== codes.join()) {
      throw new Error("The AUROC tables do not list the same ICD codes");
    }
    codes = wideCodes;
    datasets.set(source.key, { key: source.key, label: source.label, rows: toLongAuroc(wide, ordered, source.key) });
  });
  const chapterCounts = d3.rollup(datasets.get("baseline").rows, v => new Set(v.map(d => d.code)).size, d => d.chapter);
  const chapters = ICD_CHAPTERS.filter(c => chapterCounts.has(c.key)).map(c => ({ ...c, count: chapterCounts.get(c.key) }));
  return { models, codes, datasets, chapters };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

aurocDatasetLabel = key => aurocData.datasets.get(key).label
aurocChapterLabel = key => { const c = chapterByKey(key); return `${c.numeral}. ${c.short}`; }
aurocCodeInfo = new Map(icdReference.map(row => [row.code, row]))
aurocFormat = value => value.toFixed(3)
```

:::

```{ojs}

viewof kdeModels = Inputs.checkbox(aurocData.models, {
  label: "Models",
  format: modelDisplayName,
  value: aurocData.models,
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

kdeSeries = {
  const datasetKeys = kdeDataset === "both" ? ["baseline", "plus_env"] : [kdeDataset];
  const code = kdeCode.trim().toUpperCase();
  const selectedCode = aurocData.codes.includes(code) ? code : null;
  const series = [];
  datasetKeys.forEach((datasetKey) => {
    const dataset = aurocData.datasets.get(datasetKey);
    const rows = kdeChapter === "all" ? dataset.rows : dataset.rows.filter(d => d.chapter === kdeChapter);
    kdeModels.forEach((model) => {
      const modelRows = rows.filter(d => d.model === model);
      const values = modelRows.map(d => d.auroc);
      const stats = boxStats(values);
      const kde = values.length >= 2 ? gaussianKde(values, { support: [0, 1], steps: 240 }) : null;
      const codeRow = selectedCode ? modelRows.find(d => d.code === selectedCode) : null;
      series.push({
        key: `${model}|${datasetKey}`,
        model,
        dataset: datasetKey,
        datasetLabel: dataset.label,
        stats,
        kde,
        marker: codeRow && kde ? { ...codeRow, density: kdeAt(values, kde.bandwidth, codeRow.auroc) } : null,
      });
    });
  });
  return { series, selectedCode, datasetKeys };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

kdeChart = {
  const { series, selectedCode, datasetKeys } = kdeSeries;
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.className = "auroc-section";

  const scopeLabel = kdeChapter === "all" ? "all chapters" : `chapter ${aurocChapterLabel(kdeChapter)}`;
  const codeInfo = selectedCode ? aurocCodeInfo.get(selectedCode) : null;
  const titleDiv = document.createElement("div");
  titleDiv.innerHTML = `<strong style="font-size:1.1rem;color:#2c3e50;">AUROC Distribution Across ICD-10 Codes</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;">${kdeModels.length} models · ${scopeLabel} · ${datasetKeys.map(aurocDatasetLabel).join(" vs ")}${codeInfo ? ` · marker: ${codeInfo.label} ${codeInfo.description}` : ""}</span>`;
  titleDiv.style.marginBottom = "8px";
  container.appendChild(titleDiv);

  if (kdeModels.length === 0) {
    const note = document.createElement("p");
    note.className = "chart-highlight-hint";
    note.textContent = "Select at least one model to draw its AUROC distribution.";
    container.appendChild(note);
    return container;
  }

  const dash = datasetKey => (kdeDataset === "both" && datasetKey === "plus_env" ? "6,4" : null);
  const lineSeries = series.filter(s => s.kde);
  const markerSeries = series.filter(s => s.marker);
  const lineMarks = lineSeries.map(s => Plot.lineY(s.kde.points, {
    x: "x",
    y: "density",
    stroke: modelColor(s.model),
    strokeWidth: 1.8,
    strokeDasharray: dash(s.dataset),
  }));
  const markerMarks = markerSeries.map(s => Plot.dot([s.marker], {
    x: "auroc",
    y: "density",
    r: 5.5,
    fill: modelColor(s.model),
    stroke: "#fff",
    strokeWidth: 1.5,
  }));

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    className: "auroc-chart",
    width: Math.min(width, 1000),
    height: 380,
    marginLeft: 50,
    marginRight: 20,
    x: { label: "Test AUROC", domain: [0.2, 1], grid: true },
    y: { label: "Density", grid: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX([0.5], { stroke: "#9aa5b1", strokeDasharray: "3,3" }),
      ...lineMarks,
      ...markerMarks,
    ],
  });
  container.appendChild(chart);

  const tooltip = createChartTooltip(container);
  const lineGroups = [...chart.querySelectorAll('g[aria-label="line"]')];
  const dotGroups = [...chart.querySelectorAll('g[aria-label="dot"]')];
  if (lineGroups.length !== lineSeries.length || dotGroups.length !== markerSeries.length) {
    throw new Error("AUROC density marks do not match the series data");
  }
  const paths = lineGroups.map(group => group.querySelector("path"));
  bindSingleMarkTooltip(paths, tooltip, index => {
    const s = lineSeries[index];
    const st = s.stats;
    return `<strong>${modelDisplayName(s.model)}</strong> · ${modelFamily(s.model).label}<br>${s.datasetLabel} · ${scopeLabel} · n = ${st.n} codes<br>Median ${aurocFormat(st.median)} · IQR [${aurocFormat(st.q1)}, ${aurocFormat(st.q3)}]<br>Mean ${aurocFormat(st.mean)} · bandwidth ${s.kde.bandwidth.toFixed(4)}`;
  });
  const markerDots = dotGroups.map(group => group.querySelector("circle"));
  bindSingleMarkTooltip(markerDots, tooltip, index => {
    const s = markerSeries[index];
    const info = aurocCodeInfo.get(s.marker.code);
    return `<strong>${info.label}</strong> ${info.description}<br>${modelDisplayName(s.model)} · ${s.datasetLabel}<br>AUROC ${s.marker.auroc.toFixed(4)}`;
  });

  const legend = document.createElement("div");
  legend.className = "auroc-family-legend";
  const legendButtons = new Map();
  MODEL_FAMILIES.forEach((family) => {
    const members = family.models.filter(model => kdeModels.includes(model));
    if (members.length === 0) return;
    const group = document.createElement("div");
    group.className = "auroc-family";
    const heading = document.createElement("span");
    heading.className = "auroc-family-label";
    heading.textContent = family.label;
    group.appendChild(heading);
    members.forEach((model) => {
      const button = document.createElement("button");
      button.type = "button";
      button.className = "chart-highlight-action";
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
      button.title = modelFullName(model);
      const marker = document.createElement("span");
      marker.className = "chart-highlight-marker";
      marker.style.color = modelColor(model);
      marker.textContent = "●";
      button.append(marker, document.createTextNode(modelDisplayName(model)));
      group.appendChild(button);
      legendButtons.set(model, button);
    });
    legend.appendChild(group);
  });
  container.appendChild(legend);

  const targets = new Map(kdeModels.map(model => [model, []]));
  lineSeries.forEach((s, index) => targets.get(s.model).push(lineGroups[index]));
  markerSeries.forEach((s, index) => targets.get(s.model).push(dotGroups[index]));
  bindHighlightGroups({
    groupKeys: kdeModels,
    targetsByGroup: targets,
    actionsByGroup: legendButtons,
    labelForGroup: model => `Highlight ${modelDisplayName(model)}`,
  });

  const hint = document.createElement("div");
  hint.className = "chart-highlight-hint";
  hint.textContent = kdeDataset === "both"
    ? "Solid curves: Baseline. Dashed curves: + Environment. Hover or select a model to highlight it; select it again or press Esc to clear. Dashed grey line: chance (AUROC 0.5)."
    : "Hover or select a model to highlight it; select it again or press Esc to clear. Dashed grey line: chance (AUROC 0.5).";
  container.appendChild(hint);
  return container;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

kdeTable = {
  const { series, selectedCode } = kdeSeries;
  const table = document.createElement("table");
  table.className = "auroc-summary-table";
  const codeInfo = selectedCode ? aurocCodeInfo.get(selectedCode) : null;
  const columns = ["Model", "Family", "n codes", "Baseline median (IQR)", "+ Environment median (IQR)", "Δ median"];
  if (selectedCode) columns.push(`${codeInfo.label} Baseline`, `${codeInfo.label} + Environment`);
  table.innerHTML = `<caption>Per-model summary of test AUROC over ${kdeChapter === "all" ? "all chapters" : `chapter ${aurocChapterLabel(kdeChapter)}`}${selectedCode ? `, with the AUROC of ${codeInfo.label} (${codeInfo.description})` : ""}.</caption>`;
  const head = table.createTHead().insertRow();
  columns.forEach((column) => {
    const th = document.createElement("th");
    th.scope = "col";
    th.textContent = column;
    head.appendChild(th);
  });
  const body = table.createTBody();
  const rowsFor = (datasetKey, model) => {
    const dataset = aurocData.datasets.get(datasetKey);
    const rows = dataset.rows.filter(d => d.model === model && (kdeChapter === "all" || d.chapter === kdeChapter));
    return rows;
  };
  const cell = (tr, text, numeric) => {
    const td = tr.insertCell();
    td.textContent = text;
    if (numeric) td.className = "is-numeric";
  };
  kdeModels.forEach((model) => {
    const base = rowsFor("baseline", model);
    const env = rowsFor("plus_env", model);
    const baseStats = boxStats(base.map(d => d.auroc));
    const envStats = boxStats(env.map(d => d.auroc));
    const tr = body.insertRow();
    const th = document.createElement("th");
    th.scope = "row";
    th.textContent = modelDisplayName(model);
    th.title = modelFullName(model);
    tr.appendChild(th);
    cell(tr, modelFamily(model).label);
    cell(tr, String(baseStats.n), true);
    cell(tr, `${aurocFormat(baseStats.median)} (${aurocFormat(baseStats.q1)}–${aurocFormat(baseStats.q3)})`, true);
    cell(tr, `${aurocFormat(envStats.median)} (${aurocFormat(envStats.q1)}–${aurocFormat(envStats.q3)})`, true);
    const delta = envStats.median - baseStats.median;
    cell(tr, `${delta >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${aurocFormat(delta)}`, true);
    if (selectedCode) {
      cell(tr, base.find(d => d.code === selectedCode).auroc.toFixed(4), true);
      cell(tr, env.find(d => d.code === selectedCode).auroc.toFixed(4), true);
    }
  });
  const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
  wrapper.className = "auroc-table-scroll";
  wrapper.appendChild(table);
  return wrapper;
}
```

## AUROC by ICD-10 Chapter and Model {#auroc-chapter-matrix}

Codes are grouped by their WHO ICD-10 chapter, resolved from the full three-character category rather than the leading letter (chapter I spans A and B, chapters II and III share D, and VII and VIII share H). Each cell is a Tukey box plot of one model's per-code AUROC within one chapter: the box spans the interquartile range, the white line is the median, whiskers reach the furthest codes within 1.5 × IQR, and dots are outlying codes. Columns are grouped by model family; scroll horizontally to see all 17 models.

::: {.auroc-controls}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof boxDataset = Inputs.radio(["baseline", "plus_env"], {
  label: "Inputs",
  format: aurocDatasetLabel,
  value: ["baseline", "plus_env"].includes(aurocPreset) ? aurocPreset : "baseline",
})
```

```{ojs}

  label: "ICD-10 chapters",
  format: key => `${aurocChapterLabel(key)} (${aurocData.chapters.find(c => c.key === key).count})`,
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

boxMatrix = {
  const dataset = aurocData.datasets.get(boxDataset);
  const models = aurocData.models.filter(model => boxFamilies.includes(modelFamily(model).key));
  const chapters = aurocData.chapters.filter(c => boxChapters.includes(c.key));
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.className = "auroc-section";

  const titleDiv = document.createElement("div");
  titleDiv.innerHTML = `<strong style="font-size:1.1rem;color:#2c3e50;">AUROC by ICD-10 Chapter × Model</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;">${chapters.length} chapters × ${models.length} models · ${dataset.label} inputs · ${chapters.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c.count, 0)} codes</span>`;
  titleDiv.style.marginBottom = "8px";
  container.appendChild(titleDiv);

  if (models.length === 0 || chapters.length === 0) {
    const note = document.createElement("p");
    note.className = "chart-highlight-hint";
    note.textContent = "Select at least one model family and one chapter to draw the matrix.";
    container.appendChild(note);
    return container;
  }

  const chapterKeys = chapters.map(c => c.key);
  const rows = dataset.rows.filter(d => models.includes(d.model) && boxChapters.includes(d.chapter));
  const cells = summariseCells(rows);
  const cellById = new Map(cells.map(c => [`${c.chapter}|${c.model}`, c]));
  const outliers = cells.flatMap(c => c.outlierRows.map(row => ({ ...row, id: `${row.chapter}|${row.model}|${row.code}` })));
  const outlierById = new Map(outliers.map(o => [o.id, o]));

  const colWidth = 100;
  const rowHeight = 34;
  const marginTop = 44;
  const marginBottom = 28;
  const labelWidth = 236;
  const facet = { fx: "model", fy: "chapter" };
  const xDomain = [Math.floor(d3.min(rows, d => d.auroc) * 10) / 10, 1];
  const cellId = d => `${d.chapter}|${d.model}`;

  const labels = Plot.plot({
    className: "auroc-chart",
    width: labelWidth,
    height: marginTop + marginBottom + rowHeight * chapters.length,
    marginTop,
    marginBottom,
    marginLeft: labelWidth - 6,
    marginRight: 6,
    x: { axis: null, domain: xDomain },
    y: { axis: null, domain: [0, 1] },
    fx: { axis: null, domain: [models[0]] },
    fy: { label: null, domain: chapterKeys, tickFormat: key => `${aurocChapterLabel(key)} (${chapters.find(c => c.key === key).count})` },
    marks: [Plot.dot(cells.filter(c => c.model === models[0]), { x: "median", y: () => 0.5, r: 0, ...facet })],
  });

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    className: "auroc-chart",
    width: colWidth * models.length + 12,
    height: marginTop + marginBottom + rowHeight * chapters.length,
    marginTop,
    marginBottom,
    marginLeft: 6,
    marginRight: 6,
    style: { overflow: "visible" },
    x: { domain: xDomain, ticks: [0.5, 0.75, 1], tickFormat: d => d.toFixed(2), tickSize: 3, label: null },
    y: { axis: null, domain: [0, 1] },
    fx: { axis: "top", label: null, domain: models, tickFormat: modelDisplayName, padding: 0.12 },
    fy: { axis: null, domain: chapterKeys },
    marks: [
      Plot.frame({ stroke: "#d9e2ec", strokeOpacity: 0.7 }),
      Plot.ruleX([0.5], { stroke: "#9aa5b1", strokeDasharray: "2,3" }),
      Plot.ruleY(cells, { x1: "whiskerLow", x2: "whiskerHigh", y: () => 0.5, stroke: d => modelColor(d.model), strokeWidth: 1, ariaLabel: cellId, ...facet }),
      Plot.rect(cells, { x1: "q1", x2: "q3", y1: () => 0.22, y2: () => 0.78, fill: d => modelColor(d.model), fillOpacity: 0.85, ariaLabel: cellId, ...facet }),
      Plot.ruleX(cells, { x: "median", y1: () => 0.18, y2: () => 0.82, stroke: "#fff", strokeWidth: 2, ariaLabel: cellId, ...facet }),
      Plot.dot(outliers, { x: "auroc", y: () => 0.5, r: 2, fill: d => modelColor(d.model), fillOpacity: 0.75, ariaLabel: "id", ...facet }),
    ],
  });

  // The row labels sit in their own sticky column so they stay visible while
  // the 17 model columns scroll. The wrapper carries the background because
  // the site's dark theme makes every chart svg transparent.
  const labelColumn = document.createElement("div");
  labelColumn.className = "auroc-box-labels";
  labelColumn.appendChild(labels);
  chart.classList.add("auroc-box-cells");
  const scroller = document.createElement("div");
  scroller.className = "auroc-box-matrix";
  scroller.append(labelColumn, chart);
  container.appendChild(scroller);

  const tooltip = createChartTooltip(container);
  const boxes = [...chart.querySelectorAll('g[aria-label="rect"] rect[aria-label]')];
  const dots = [...chart.querySelectorAll('g[aria-label="dot"] circle[aria-label]')];
  const whiskers = [...chart.querySelectorAll('g[aria-label="rule"] line[aria-label]')];
  if (boxes.length !== cells.length || dots.length !== outliers.length || whiskers.length !== cells.length * 2) {
    throw new Error("Box matrix marks do not match the summarised cells");
  }
  const boxCells = boxes.map(box => cellById.get(box.getAttribute("aria-label")));
  const dotRows = dots.map(dot => outlierById.get(dot.getAttribute("aria-label")));
  const whiskerCells = whiskers.map(line => cellById.get(line.getAttribute("aria-label")));
  if (boxCells.includes(undefined) || dotRows.includes(undefined) || whiskerCells.includes(undefined)) {
    throw new Error("Box matrix marks carry unknown cell labels");
  }
  const describeCell = c => {
    const chapter = chapterByKey(c.chapter);
    return `<strong>${modelDisplayName(c.model)}</strong> · ${modelFamily(c.model).label}<br>${chapter.numeral}. ${chapter.title}<br>${dataset.label} · n = ${c.n} codes<br>Median ${aurocFormat(c.median)} · IQR [${aurocFormat(c.q1)}, ${aurocFormat(c.q3)}]<br>Whiskers [${aurocFormat(c.whiskerLow)}, ${aurocFormat(c.whiskerHigh)}] · ${c.outliers.length} outlier${c.outliers.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}<br>Mean ${aurocFormat(c.mean)} · range [${aurocFormat(c.min)}, ${aurocFormat(c.max)}]`;
  };
  bindSingleMarkTooltip(boxes, tooltip, index => describeCell(boxCells[index]));
  bindSingleMarkTooltip(whiskers, tooltip, index => describeCell(whiskerCells[index]));
  bindSingleMarkTooltip(dots, tooltip, index => {
    const row = dotRows[index];
    const info = aurocCodeInfo.get(row.code);
    const chapter = chapterByKey(row.chapter);
    return `<strong>${info.label}</strong> ${info.description}<br>${modelDisplayName(row.model)} · ${chapter.numeral}. ${chapter.short}<br>AUROC ${row.auroc.toFixed(4)} (outlier)`;
  });

  const legend = document.createElement("div");
  legend.className = "auroc-family-legend";
  const legendButtons = new Map();
  MODEL_FAMILIES.forEach((family) => {
    const members = family.models.filter(model => models.includes(model));
    if (members.length === 0) return;
    const group = document.createElement("div");
    group.className = "auroc-family";
    const heading = document.createElement("span");
    heading.className = "auroc-family-label";
    heading.textContent = family.label;
    group.appendChild(heading);
    members.forEach((model) => {
      const button = document.createElement("button");
      button.type = "button";
      button.className = "chart-highlight-action";
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
      button.title = modelFullName(model);
      const marker = document.createElement("span");
      marker.className = "chart-highlight-marker";
      marker.style.color = modelColor(model);
      marker.textContent = "■";
      button.append(marker, document.createTextNode(modelDisplayName(model)));
      group.appendChild(button);
      legendButtons.set(model, button);
    });
    legend.appendChild(group);
  });
  container.appendChild(legend);

  // Every mark of a model dims together. The marks themselves are not made
  // focusable (there are hundreds); the legend buttons and a click on a box
  // drive the highlight instead.
  const elementsByModel = new Map(models.map(model => [model, []]));
  boxes.forEach((box, index) => elementsByModel.get(boxCells[index].model).push(box));
  whiskers.forEach((line, index) => elementsByModel.get(whiskerCells[index].model).push(line));
  dots.forEach((dot, index) => elementsByModel.get(dotRows[index].model).push(dot));
  const controller = createHighlightController(models, (active) => {
    models.forEach((model) => {
      const opacity = highlightOpacity(model, active);
      elementsByModel.get(model).forEach(element => { element.style.opacity = opacity; });
      const button = legendButtons.get(model);
      button.classList.toggle("is-active", model === active);
      button.classList.toggle("is-muted", active !== null && model !== active);
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(controller.pinned() === model));
    });
  });
  models.forEach(model => bindHighlightTarget(legendButtons.get(model), model, controller));
  boxes.forEach((box, index) => {
    box.style.cursor = "pointer";
    box.addEventListener("click", () => controller.toggle(boxCells[index].model));
  });

  const hint = document.createElement("div");
  hint.className = "chart-highlight-hint";
  hint.textContent = "Hover a box, whisker or outlier for its statistics. Hover or select a model in the legend, or click a box, to highlight that model across every chapter; select it again or press Esc to clear.";
  container.appendChild(hint);
  return container;
}
```

## Evaluation Metrics Comparison

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

evalData = {

  // Model names pass through the shared registry so this chart spells them
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

evalChart = {
  const filtered = evalData.filter(d => d.metric === selectedMetric);
  const diseases = [...new Set(filtered.map(d => d.disease))];
  const models = [...new Set(filtered.map(d => d.model))];

  // Sort diseases by proposed model performance (descending)
  const proposed = filtered.filter(d => d.is_proposed);
  diseases.sort((a, b) => {
    const va = proposed.find(d => d.disease === a)?.value || 0;
    const vb = proposed.find(d => d.disease === b)?.value || 0;
    return vb - va;
  });

  const proposedModel = modelDisplayName("ALIGATEHR-Gen");
  const grayScale = ["#888","#aaa","#666","#999","#bbb","#777","#ccc","#555","#ddd"];
  const modelColors = {};
  let gi = 0;
  for (const m of models) {
    modelColors[m] = m === proposedModel ? "#2c5aa0" : grayScale[gi++ % grayScale.length];
  }

  const dotMarks = models.map((model) =>
    Plot.dot(filtered.filter(d => d.model === model), {
      x: "value",
      y: "disease",
      fill: modelColors[model],
      r: model === proposedModel ? 6 : 4,
      symbol: model === proposedModel ? "circle" : "diamond2",
    })
  );

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 1000,
    height: 420,
    marginLeft: 180,
    marginRight: 20,
    x: { label: selectedMetric, grid: true },
    y: { label: null, domain: diseases },
    marks: dotMarks,
  });

  // Wrap with title
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  const titleDiv = document.createElement("div");
  titleDiv.innerHTML = `<strong style="font-size:1.1rem;color:#2c3e50;">Model Performance Comparison</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;">${models.length} models × ${diseases.length} diseases · Metric: ${selectedMetric}</span>`;
  titleDiv.style.marginBottom = "8px";
  container.appendChild(titleDiv);
  container.appendChild(chart);

  const tooltip = createChartTooltip(container);

  const dotGroups = [...chart.querySelectorAll('g[aria-label="dot"]')];
  if (dotGroups.length !== models.length) {
    throw new Error("Model performance mark groups do not match the model data");
  }
  const tooltipPoints = [];
  const tooltipRows = [];
  models.forEach((model, index) => {
    const rows = filtered.filter(d => d.model === model);
    const points = [...dotGroups[index].querySelectorAll("circle, path")];
    if (points.length !== rows.length) {
      throw new Error(`Model performance points do not match ${model}`);
    }
    tooltipPoints.push(...points);
    tooltipRows.push(...rows);
  });
  bindSingleMarkTooltip(tooltipPoints, tooltip, index => {
    const d = tooltipRows[index];
    const interval = d.ci_lower != null
      ? `<br>CI: [${d.ci_lower.toFixed(4)}, ${d.ci_upper.toFixed(4)}]`
      : "";
    return `<strong>${d.model}</strong><br>${d.disease}<br>${selectedMetric}: ${d.value.toFixed(4)}${interval}`;
  });

  // Custom legend
  const legendDiv = document.createElement("div");
  legendDiv.className = "chart-highlight-legend";
  container.appendChild(legendDiv);

  const legendButtons = new Map();
  models.forEach((model) => {
    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.className = "chart-highlight-action";
    button.classList.toggle("is-proposed", model === proposedModel);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
    const marker = document.createElement("span");
    marker.className = "chart-highlight-marker";
    marker.style.color = modelColors[model];
    marker.textContent = model === proposedModel ? "●" : "◆";
    button.append(marker, document.createTextNode(model));
    legendDiv.appendChild(button);
    legendButtons.set(model, button);
  });

  const seriesNodes = new Map(models.map((model, index) => [
    model,
    [dotGroups[index]],
  ]));
  bindHighlightGroups({
    groupKeys: models,
    targetsByGroup: seriesNodes,
    actionsByGroup: legendButtons,
    labelForGroup: model => `Highlight ${model}`,
  });

  return container;
}
```
